reasoning_content: The earlier `timeout 90 npm start` may still be running on 9001. Let me check processes and probe port 9001.

action.command: ps aux | grep -E "vite|npm start" | grep -v grep; echo "---ports---"; (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null) | grep -E "900[0-9]"; echo "---probe 9001/9002---"; for port in 9001 9002; do for p in / /index.html; do printf "%s%s -> " "$port" "$p"; curl -sk -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" "https://localhost:$port$p"; done; done
